name: task-workspaces
description: Isolated multi-repository worktrees per task: absolute paths, dependency reuse via copy-on-write clones, checkpoints before cleanup and restore of removed folders.

interface.longDescription: Gives every coding task its own Git worktrees in one or more repositories: current absolute paths, fresh base branches, dependency reuse through copy-on-write clones, checkpoints of unfinished work before cleanup, restore of removed folders, disk quotas and a read-only inventory of all worktrees.
defaultPrompt: Prepare isolated worktrees for this task
Show my task worktrees and disk usage
Pause this task and free its disk space
